The '''NA LCS 2015 Summer Split''' was the sixth split of the [[North American League of Legends Championship Series]] (NA LCS), organized by Riot Games. The regular season ran from May 30 to August 23, 2015, with matches played at the Riot Games Studio in Los Angeles, while the Playoffs concluded at Madison Square Garden in New York City. Ten teams competed in a Double Round-Robin Best-of-One format during the regular season, with the top six advancing to the Single Elimination Best-of-Five Playoffs. The split featured a $100,000 USD prize pool, with the champion earning direct qualification to the [[World_Championship/2015|2015 World Championship]], while the eighth and ninth place teams were sent to the [[LCS/North_America/2016/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion Tournament]] and the last place team was relegated to the [[Challenger Series/North_America/2016/Spring|Challenger Series]].

Between the Spring and Summer splits, several roster changes and promotion/relegation matches reshaped the league’s landscape. [[Team Dignitas]] and [[Team Dragon Knights]] qualified through the [[LCS/North America/2015/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]], [[Enemy]] won the [[Challenger Series/North America/2015/Spring|Challenger Series]] and joined the NA LCS alongside the returning Spring Split teams. The Summer Split showcased intense competition across all ten teams, culminating in the playoffs that determined North America’s representative for the [[World_Championship/2015|2015 World Championship]].
